name: Spacetime Gaussian Feature Splatting
definition: A representation for modeling dynamic 3D scenes using Spacetime Gaussians (STG) that combine 3D Gaussians with temporal components to model emerging/vanishing content as well as motion/deformation.
summary: Spacetime Gaussian Feature Splatting is a dynamic scene representation that extends 3D Gaussian Splatting to 4D spacetime, using polynomial motion models and neural feature vectors for real-time rendering.
